Hadorph documented ancient monuments during extensive voyages in Sweden, and he collected a great many older manuscripts, such as collections of laws.  He also made many drawings of runestones, and supervised the production of more than 1000 woodcuts of runestones.
Forshang | Forshang Buddhism is the revelation of Buddha-Nature, founded by the Venerable Master Miao Kung Bodhisattva and succeeding Master Yuan Dao Bodhisattva in the early stage of the Republic of China, revering Da Zi Zai Wang Fo (the origin of Buddha-Nature) as the Originator.
